subject: Post-demo: procurement route & vendor info for PO vs card vs marketplace
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lowe <samantha.lowe@brightlane.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: procurement route & vendor info for PO vs card vs marketplace

Hi Samantha — thank you again for taking the demo on Friday. A quick recap and suggested next steps so your procurement/finance/legal teams have what they need to make a decision: 

1) Procurement options we discussed: PO (via vendor invoice), Corporate card (self-serve signup + card payment), or Marketplace listing (AWS Marketplace) — each has different timelines and PO prerequisites.
2) Your stated preference on the call was to evaluate PO first but confirm whether the procurement team will accept vendor invoices or wants marketplace/subscription billing.
3) Action items from our side: attach a short procurement checklist and a commercial overview with typical SLAs and sample SOW language. We can also produce an MSA redline and respond to any vendor questionnaires.

Attachments: Redwood-Commercial-Overview-2027.pdf (one-pager), procurement-checklist-brightlane.xlsx (fillable).

If helpful, I can loop in our Finance lead to answer PO/process questions and provide tax/invoicing details. Are you able to confirm the procurement owner and whether they require 3 bids or an internal approval matrix? If you prefer, propose two times for a 20-min alignment with procurement this week.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

--

Alex — thanks for the summary and the docs. Quick update from my side: 

- Procurement is Melissa Chang (copied on the thread below) but she is out until Thursday. Diego (copied) is helping triage in the meantime.
- Our preference is PO but Finance has flagged that vendor needs to be in our vendor registry and provide W-9 / tax details. They also asked whether Redwood is on AWS Marketplace — that speeds approvals for us.
- There will be a short vendor questionnaire from Security (standard) — estimated 2–3 business days to complete once we have the artifact links.

So next steps for us: confirm vendor registry package and W-9, and check whether Marketplace option exists. If you can provide an invoice template and point to any existing Marketplace listing (or an ETA), that would help.

Thanks,
Samantha

Thanks Samantha — appreciate the clarity. Quick notes and what we can deliver today: 

- Marketplace: Redwood is listed on AWS Marketplace (link below). I'll confirm the listing ID and send the public SKU/contract info by EOD. Marketplace usually shortens vendor onboarding.
- Vendor registry package: attached a PDF with W-9, our standard invoice template, and our primary billing contact. If your finance team needs a separate vendor form filled out, send it along and we'll complete it immediately.
- Security questionnaire: Marissa (cc) will coordinate answers for common sections and can provide an SOC2 summary and evidence links.

Proposed next step: 20-min sync with your procurement owner + our Finance (Ben) and Marissa to agree on the fastest invoicing path and timelines. Suggested slots: Thu 13:00–13:30 PT or Fri 10:00–10:30 PT. Which works for Melissa (or Diego in her absence)?

Alex

Alex / team — quick status update from procurement backlog: 

- Melissa is back this morning and reviewing the docs. She asked whether Redwood has any pre-existing Marketplace reseller references (quick customer names) to justify expedited listing — can you share 1–2 names we can use as references?
- Finance confirmed they will accept a PO but need the formal vendor onboarding packet submitted through our portal (I will upload your W-9 and invoice template). ETA for vendor creation: 7–10 business days once uploaded.
- Security has a couple small items in the questionnaire about data residency and log retention — Marissa, can your team provide the SOC2 appendix and a short note on retention policy for inference logs?

Diego here is happy to run the portal upload with the materials you attached. If we want to speed this up, Ben or Alex, can you provide an editable vendor form (fillable PDF) and a named reference (company + contact) we can call?

Thanks — will circle back after I upload the packet.
